subject: BLOCKER compute: (1) v2Buffers[8] indexed by Metal slot 0..30 (OOB alias into v2Textures); (2) native config sends TDG2 for TGP1 variants, bridge refuses
body:
Source hashes: runtime_pipeline.inc cad3849b, compute_frontend.m 2b1076be, nord2_metal_bridge.c ae293c43, pipeline_format.h 51cf599d.
(1) runtime_pipeline.inc:407-409 does job->v2Buffers[desc->metal_index] but compute_frontend.m:323 declares TeguBuffer *v2Buffers[8]; desc->metal_index is a Metal slot 0..30 (Rust accepts slot<31, only native binding<8). Compile-time proof (static asserts pass, aliases v2Buffers[9]==v2Textures[1], [30]==[22]): clang -fsyntax-only <native flags> gpu/build/claude-audit-20261025/v2buffers_alias_probe.m. Effect: a buffer at slot>=8 writes into the v2Textures slot, so a later texture retain is skipped (object not held by the job) and a buffer retain can be skipped if the aliased texture slot is populated -> missing retain/UAF after the app releases. Fix: index by native binding (<8) or size v2Buffers[31].
(2) In the native config (-DTEGU_GRAPHICS_BRIDGE -DTEGU_AIR_BRIDGE), compute_frontend.m:1776 sends everything except packageVersion==1 to tegu_runtime_dispatch_v2; function-created pipelines have packageVersion 0 (only newTeguPipelineWithPackage sets it, line 867). A buffer-only kernel then compiles a TGP1 variant (require_v2=0) but runtime_pipeline.inc:372-400 always builds a TDG2 wire. nord2_metal_bridge.c:257-262 dispatch_v2 requires p->version==2 -> BAD. Probe with the real bridge: cc ... gpu/build/claude-audit-20261025/tgp1_tdg2_probe.c => TDG1 on TGP1 rc=0 submit=1; TDG2 on TGP1 rc=0xe00002c2 no submit. runtime_frontend_host_test.m (check_runtime_v1_aligned.py) defines TEGU_AIR_BRIDGE+TEGU_MALI_BRIDGE but NOT TEGU_GRAPHICS_BRIDGE so it compiles the legacy dispatcher and does not cover the native config. Fix: for a selected TGP1 variant emit the unchanged 272-byte TDG1 (or have the bridge accept TDG2 on TGP1), and add a host test built with the native macro set.
